Inventory Item

The Inventory Item view displays comprehensive information about a specific inventory item in your system.

This view provides a complete overview of the item's details, including its code, name, description, unit of measurement, and current pricing information.

Available Actions

From this view, you can perform several actions:

• Click the Edit button to modify the item's details, such as name, description, or pricing

• View all transactions related to this inventory item to track its movement and usage

• Manage file attachments to store documents, images, or other files related to the item

• Access quantity information to see current stock levels, items on order, and reserved quantities

Key Information

The view displays essential information such as the item's purchase price and sale price, helping you monitor profitability at a glance.

You can also see the item's current quantity on hand and track inventory movements through the transaction history.

Learn more about editing inventory items: Inventory Item — Edit
